children: Asos still needs to prove it can generate profitable and sustainable growth despite an upbeat trading update, RBC Capital Markets' Richard Chamberlain and Manjari Dhar write. "To become more investable, we think Asos needs stronger top-line progression and continued deleveraging, albeit both are now trending in the right direction," the analysts say. RBC says it thinks the fashion retailer has been successfully trading sales for profits. The bank has a neutral rating on the stock and a 400 pence price target. Shares are 8% higher at 464.50 pence. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
